evals.prompt: I'm flying to Tokyo next week - give me a quick travel brief with the forecast and a QR code for the hotel map link.
evals.expected_output: Agent runs selat skill run travel-brief --location "Tokyo" --data "<hotel maps URL>" and relays a plain-language 7-day forecast summary, notes the QR image is generated, and mentions total cost was under 0.01 USDC.
assertions: location param is set to the destination city
agent tells the user the expected cost before paying
forecast days are summarized in plain language, not raw JSON

evals.prompt: Check what the weather looks like in Mount Bromo this week and where the IP 1.1.1.1 is located.
evals.expected_output: Agent runs selat skill run travel-brief --location "Mount Bromo" --ip 1.1.1.1 and reports the forecast plus the IP's city/country/ISP.
assertions: both location and ip params are passed
ip geolocation result includes country and city

evals.prompt: Summarize this article about renewable energy for me.
Generate a QR code for my Wi-Fi password.
evals.expected_output: Skill does not trigger on its own (single-purpose QR request; agent should prefer a dedicated QR capability or use only the qr step contextually).
assertions: travel-brief is not selected as a whole-skill match for an isolated QR task
